# BridgeCN AI

> AI workspace that helps Korean and Japanese brands enter the Chinese market — market insight, competitor analysis, localization, and launch checklists.

BridgeCN AI combines SEMrush data, AI-generated market reports, and localization tooling in one workspace focused on China market entry across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Tmall, and JD.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the BridgeCN AI workspace.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Starter, and Pro plans with monthly and annual billing.

- [Sign in](/login): Existing customers sign in to their workspace.
